scenario: An integration authorization is granted under policy context v1; before the landing executes, the organization publishes policy context v2 adding a mandatory provenance control.
when: the landing executes after the policy change

reasons: the authorization's policy context v1 no longer matches the v2 context in force
policy drift stales the authorization; re-authorization against v2 is required
the refusal names the changed policy version, not a generic failure
must_not: execute under the superseded policy context because the grant predates the change
apply v2 selectively while keeping the v1 grant record
silently re-issue the authorization without the accountable actor
